title: gray drawer liner
text: gray drawer liner. This isn't exactly what I was expecting.... but it works.  The color gray is good.  There is no sticky back which was not a surprise.  I didn't want a sticky back.  But the top has a bit of a texture - and it feels like a thin rubber.  It does cut well and stay down without being sticky. You will need a razor knife and a ruler to make sure your lines are straight.  It wipes up well.  I just wish the top was fully smooth without a visual texture - it looks a bit... industrial?  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful and I hope my review was helpful to you.
